raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` and an explicit Triton MoE runner, compressed-tensors CHANNEL FP8 layers receive AITER-shuffled weights and lose 128 reduction elements in the non-block FP8 kernel (1024 → 896 in the regression). Both cause incorrect outputs.

## Modifications

- Shuffle CT CHANNEL FP8 weights only for an actual AITER runner.
- Match the non-block FP8 kernel's padding calculation to its existing caller when AITER is enabled.
- Add an AMD CI-registered runtime quantization test under `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/`, covering checkpoint loading, postprocessing, and numerical Triton/AITER MoE comparisons with 1- and 33-token inputs.

Related: [#41636](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41636) addresses the shuffle mechanism in `Fp8MoEMethod` block-FP8; this PR fixes the separate compressed-tensors CHANNEL path and the non-block kernel dimension calculation.

## Accuracy Tests

Tested on MI355X (gfx950), Python 3.10.12, PyTorch `2.9.1+rocm7.2.0.git7e1940d4`, HIP `7.2.26015-fc0010cf6a`, using the official image:

```
lmsysorg/sglang-rocm@sha256:8cb29fc407c2e46bdb1866c5edb91f109ac1acbbcb6905089beaa6c79b0813a2
```

Base: `9db58ab547516435b544ae050dd6c2f91b52bcf3`  
Head: `7d7d8b79eec61eda1884c54311b2580bd6159cff`

Layer controls use identical seeded weights, routing and test source, `SGLANG_MOE_PADDING=0`, isolated processes/caches, and verified import paths/hashes.

| Variant | Explicit Triton, 1 / 33 tokens | AITER, 1 / 33 tokens |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base, AITER disabled | pass / pass | not run |
| Base, AITER enabled | fail / fail | pass / pass |
| Only shuffle guard | fail / fail (cosine 0.7757 / 0.8207) | pass / pass |
| Only kernel padding fix | fail / fail | pass / pass |
| Both fixes | pass / pass | pass / pass |

Both final test methods pass without errors/skips. The independent reference uses dequantized checkpoint weights and identical routing; fixed thresholds are cosine > 0.99 and relative L2 < 0.1. Controls fail numerically, establishing that both fixes are required.

A separate Quark per-tensor dynamic regression covers another shared-kernel consumer: base/AITER off passes, base/AITER on fails both numerical subtests, and patched/AITER on passes (no errors/skips).

<details>
<summary>Reproduce the GPU-tested revisions on MI35x</summary>

Run inside the image above, from outside the source tree:

```bash
git clone --branch lunarwhite/ct-fp8-runner-layout https://github.com/lunarwhite/sglang.git /tmp/ct-sglang
git -C /tmp/ct-sglang checkout --detach 7d7d8b79eec61eda1884c54311b2580bd6159cff
cd /tmp
export SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_MOE_PADDING=0 SGLANG_TEST_MAX_RETRY=0
export SGLANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/ct-sglang-head-cache
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/ct-sglang/python python /tmp/ct-sglang/test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_compressed_tensors_fp8_moe_layout.py
```

To reproduce the controls with the same test file (each command is a separate process):

```bash
git -C /tmp/ct-sglang worktree add --detach /tmp/ct-base 9db58ab547516435b544ae050dd6c2f91b52bcf3
git -C /tmp/ct-sglang worktree add --detach /tmp/ct-kernel-only 9db58ab547516435b544ae050dd6c2f91b52bcf3
git -C /tmp/ct-kernel-only restore --source=7d7d8b79eec61eda1884c54311b2580bd6159cff -- python/sglang/kernels/ops/moe/fused_moe_triton_kernels.py
TEST_FILE=/tmp/ct-sglang/test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_compressed_tensors_fp8_moe_layout.py
# Pass: AITER-disabled control, one test method.
SGLANG_USE_AITER=0 SGLANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/ct-control-cache PYTHONPATH=/tmp/ct-base/python python "$TEST_FILE" TestCompressedTensorsFp8MoELayout.test_explicit_triton
# Expected numerical failure in Triton, with AITER passing:
SGLANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/ct-base-cache PYTHONPATH=/tmp/ct-base/python python "$TEST_FILE"
SGLANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/ct-kernel-cache PYTHONPATH=/tmp/ct-kernel-only/python python "$TEST_FILE"
```

</details>

The separate AITER-disabled + padding-enabled configuration is outside this validation.

### Real-checkpoint validation

`RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-dynamic`, revision `10a439027a4fd228adc03a7bffb1aac10a179938`, was evaluated on the same MI355X image and base/head sources. All four arms observed actual CT CHANNEL execution in all 48 layers and verified the loaded source hashes. TP1, eager execution, AITER enabled, padding disabled; 200 GSM8K test examples, five demonstrations from the train split, greedy decoding, maximum 512 generated tokens.

| Configuration | Correct / 200 |
| --- | --- |
| Base, AITER runner | 180 |
| Base, AITER runner repeat | 179 |
| Base, explicit Triton runner | 0 |
| Patched, explicit Triton runner | 181 |

All 800 predictions were independently rescored and prompt/dataset hashes verified. Every base Triton output hit the 512-token cap. This is a configuration-specific sanity check, not full-dataset accuracy or statistical equivalence; default AITER is the known-good reference.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

A separate fixed-output probe (four prompts, 64 tokens each, three timed repeats after warmup) measured median output rates of 103.88 tok/s for base Triton and 104.75 tok/s for patched Triton; AITER reference runs measured 99.71 and 103.64 tok/s. This bounded probe is not a production throughput or speedup claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A, no new option or API)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

_Disclosure: Found by [Hyperloom](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Hyperloom) session analysis, reviewed and validated by human._

@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@
+"""CHANNEL FP8 weights must retain the layout consumed by the selected runner."""
+
+import os
+import unittest
+
+# Set before importing SGLang: quantization modules cache this flag at import.
+os.environ.setdefault("SGLANG_USE_AITER", "1")
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import MoeRunnerBackend
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.compressed_tensors import (
+    CompressedTensorsConfig,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.schemes import (
+    CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.loader import DefaultModelLoader
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_flags, get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils import get_bool_env_var, is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.layer_ut_utils import assert_output_close, init_single_process_dist
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=60, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+E, H, INTERMEDIATE, TOPK = 8, 1024, 1024, 2
+QUANT_CONFIG = {
+    "quant_method": "compressed-tensors",
+    "format": "float-quantized",
+    "config_groups": {
+        "group_0": {
+            "targets": ["re:.*mlp\\.experts.*"],
+            "weights": {
+                "num_bits": 8,
+                "type": "float",
+                "symmetric": True,
+                "strategy": "channel",
+                "dynamic": False,
+            },
+            "input_activations": {
+                "num_bits": 8,
+                "type": "float",
+                "symmetric": True,
+                "strategy": "token",
+                "dynamic": True,
+            },
+        }
+    },
+    "ignore": ["lm_head"],
+}
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_hip(), "requires ROCm")
+class TestCompressedTensorsFp8MoELayout(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        init_single_process_dist(master_port=29639)
+
+    def _check_runner(self, backend):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import FusedMoE
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopKConfig, select_experts
+
+        with (
+            get_context().override_server_args(model_path="dummy"),
+            get_flags().moe.override(runner_backend=backend),
+            get_parallel().override(
+                moe_ep_size=1,
+                moe_ep_rank=0,
+                moe_tp_size=1,
+                moe_tp_rank=0,
+                tp_size=1,
+                tp_rank=0,
+            ),
+            torch.device("cuda"),
+            torch.inference_mode(),
+        ):
+            model = torch.nn.Module()
+            model.experts = FusedMoE(
+                num_experts=E,
+                hidden_size=H,
+                intermediate_size=INTERMEDIATE,
+                layer_id=0,
+                top_k=TOPK,
+                params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                quant_config=CompressedTensorsConfig.from_config(QUANT_CONFIG),
+                prefix="model.layers.0.mlp.experts",
+            )
+            self.assertIs(type(model.experts.scheme), CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE)
+            self.assertEqual(model.experts.scheme.runner.runner_backend, backend)
+
+            # CPU generation makes checkpoint bytes identical across GPU backends.
+            gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(17)
+            reference_weights = {}
+            for expert in range(E):
+                for shard, rows, cols in (
+                    ("w1", INTERMEDIATE, H),
+                    ("w3", INTERMEDIATE, H),
+                    ("w2", H, INTERMEDIATE),
+                ):
+                    weight = torch.randn(rows, cols, generator=gen, device="cpu")
+                    weight /= cols**0.5
+                    scale = weight.abs().amax(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8) / 448
+                    quantized = (
+                        (weight / scale).clamp(-448, 448).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+                    )
+                    reference_weights[expert, shard] = (
+                        quantized.float() * scale
+                    ).cuda()
+                    prefix = "w2" if shard == "w2" else "w13"
+                    for suffix, value in (
+                        ("weight", quantized),
+                        ("weight_scale", scale),
+                    ):
+                        name = f"{prefix}_{suffix}"
+                        model.experts.weight_loader(
+                            getattr(model.experts, name),
+                            value.cuda(),
+                            name,
+                            shard_id=shard,
+                            expert_id=expert,
+                        )
+            DefaultModelLoader.postprocess_weights(model, torch.device("cuda"))
+
+            for tokens in (1, 33):
+                with self.subTest(tokens=tokens, backend=backend):
+                    x = (
+                        torch.randn(tokens, H, generator=gen, device="cpu")
+                        .cuda()
+                        .bfloat16()
+                    )
+                    logits = torch.randn(tokens, E, generator=gen, device="cpu").cuda()
+                    topk = select_experts(
+                        hidden_states=x,
+                        router_logits=logits,
+                        topk_config=TopKConfig(top_k=TOPK, renormalize=True),
+                    )
+                    ref = torch.zeros(tokens, H, dtype=torch.float32)
+                    for expert in range(E):
+                        gate = F.linear(x.float(), reference_weights[expert, "w1"])
+                        up = F.linear(x.float(), reference_weights[expert, "w3"])
+                        down = F.linear(
+                            F.silu(gate) * up, reference_weights[expert, "w2"]
+                        )
+                        routing = (topk.topk_weights * (topk.topk_ids == expert)).sum(
+                            dim=-1, keepdim=True
+                        )
+                        ref += down * routing
+                    out = model.experts.forward(x, topk)
+                    assert_output_close(self, out, ref, cos_threshold=0.99)
+                    relative_error = (out.float() - ref).norm() / ref.norm()
+                    self.assertLess(relative_error.item(), 0.1)
+
+    def test_explicit_triton(self):
+        self._check_runner(MoeRunnerBackend.TRITON)
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_USE_AITER"), "requires AITER enabled")
+    def test_aiter(self):
+        self._check_runner(MoeRunnerBackend.AITER)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
